scope: Actual JavaScript orchestration/cache/backend modules, deterministic network/Cache Storage/quota fixtures; no browser automation or full-pack network transfer.

tests.name: Automatic preparation visits every nonempty record, without decoding the collection
A new session inventories committed files and resumes with no repeated download
Idle preparation uses one slot; current and nearby sections preempt it
An urgent selected slice preempts a collection fetch on a one-slot connection
A foreground consumer joins an encoded collection fetch and decodes it without refetching
Explicit pause cancels pending collection work and resume retains committed progress
Pausing neighbor warming in Echo or Probe leaves collection preparation running
Quota estimate blocks the full download, keeps current images usable, and can resume
A real Cache.put quota failure pauses rather than evicting/re-downloading completed files
Storage denial avoids a throwaway full download and preserves decoded foreground loading
Save-data pauses automatic preparation and explicit Resume permits one low-priority task
Hidden-page pause resumes automatically when the page becomes visible
Network failures retry finitely while other collection files finish
Persistent budget covers the complete real manifest and protects its entries from LRU eviction
Actual worker protocol configures and stores encoded collection files without image decoding
Disposing during worker storage inventory cannot start a fallback operation
